summary: FRONTEND-ONLY test (web preview, 390x844, public URL) of the paywall-fallback + onboarding-loop fix. ALL 6 REQUESTED FLOWS PASS. (1) Fresh user (localStorage cleared) completed the full onboarding (splash -> welcome -> referral -> 20 questions -> 'Generate My Profile' -> generating screen) and landed ONCE on /subscription?from=onboarding showing the AuthGate ('Create Account or Sign In'); URL polled for 12s = single stable URL, no bounce to /(tabs). (2) localStorage 'hera_onboarded' = '"true"' (AsyncStorage adapter JSON-encodes values — this is correct); reload of '/' -> /subscription and stayed stable 10s (not back to splash). (3) New non-premium user delivered+loop568@resend.dev via OTP (code_hash override) -> local TrialSummaryStep rendered ('Try Hera Free for 7 Days.', Annual/Monthly toggle works: 'Then $9.99 per month' after Monthly tap). NO 'Paywall is not available' text anywhere. Graceful empty state shown: 'Subscription options are unavailable right now.' + 'Tap to retry'. Tapping retry (with RevenueCat requests delayed 2s via route) showed spinner + 'Checking…', fired exactly 1 new GET api.revenuecat.com/v1/subscribers/<id>/offerings, then returned to 'Tap to retry' on /subscription; rapid double-tap also safe. (4) No loop: 12s watch on /subscription = 0 navigation events; goto '/' -> /subscription once (plan screen, not auth gate since logged in) and stable; direct /journal -> SubscriptionGuard replaced to /subscription once and stopped. (5) Demo regression: /login demo@heraapp.com -> password stage -> HeraDemo2024! -> Home ('Beautiful Soul, what do you want to manifest?' + tab bar), stable 10s, no paywall DOM ever seen; reload '/' -> Home, no paywall flash. Also demo via the subscription AuthGate right after onboarding (OTP 1234) -> Home with onboarding name 'Tester', stable. (6) Console: zero errors, no 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Only pre-existing web warnings (require cycle, shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents deprecations, useNativeDriver fallback). Native RevenueCatUI paywall path (HAS_NATIVE_PAYWALL) cannot be tested on web — code-reviewed only.

issues: On native, a non-subscribed user whose offerings are empty has no forward path (only retry / Restore Purchases / Terms) — expected per brief, but consider a friendlier hint (e.g. 'Check your connection or try again later') or a support link so App Review doesn't see a dead end.
At 390x844 the sticky CTA gradient overlays the 'No charge today · Cancel anytime' badge until scrolled — cosmetic.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Web AsyncStorage adapter (src/utils/async-storage.ts -> storage util) JSON-encodes values: to pre-seed onboarding set localStorage.setItem('hera_onboarded', JSON.stringify('true')) — raw 'true' is NOT recognized and lands on /onboarding. To sign in a new OTP user, run `python /app/backend/tests/otp_override_watcher.py <email> 4321 300 &` then enter 4321 in the app (it rewrites db.otps code_hash whenever a new code is issued). Onboarding automation: tap splash, then loop clicking 'Skip' if visible else fill visible inputs + 'Continue'/'Done'; final screen needs 'No' + partner text + 'Generate My Profile'; GeneratingScreen auto-navigates to /subscription?from=onboarding. Expo Router maps /(tabs) to URL '/'.
rca_of_issue: Verified fix: previous thin subscription.tsx rendered only RevenueCatUI.Paywall -> empty offering -> 'Paywall is not available' dead end; Close -> /(tabs) -> SubscriptionGuard -> /subscription loop. Now local paywall is the default and native paywall only renders with packages; on web the empty-offerings state shows the retry UI and routing is stable.
